metadata.purpose: Evaluation-only synthetic diagnostic challenge, grouped by requisition. No training or tuning split.
metadata.provenance: Every profile, requisition and label was authored for A4 before the controlled run. No source resume, job posting or independently reviewed suitability label was used.

label_policy.expected_evidence: Judge only the candidate's claim for each named requirement. Recognize explicit declarations and unambiguous same-technology names. Keep transferable nonidentical skills, insufficient material and unsupported claims distinct.
label_policy.semantic_order: Each ordered triple lists the profile expected to be more topically related to the same job, the profile expected to be less related, and the reason.
label_policy.qualification_order: Each ordered triple lists the profile with stronger evidence for explicitly scoped job requirements, a comparison profile and the reason. This is an evidence or eligibility contrast, not a hiring or suitability judgment.

job_requisition.title: Python API Engineer
job_requisition.description: Build Python API services with FastAPI. Develop scalable web endpoints, run integration tests, and deploy services using Docker.

candidate_profile.headline: Backend Engineer
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Built async web endpoints with FastAPI and deployed API services with Docker.

cases.rationale: Python is declared. FastAPI and Docker are used in work examples.

candidate_profile.headline: Python API Engineer
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Built Python API services, developed scalable web endpoints, ran integration tests, and deployed services using Docker. The endpoints use Django.

cases.rationale: The candidate is topically close and has Django experience. No FastAPI claim appears.

candidate_profile.headline: Python API Engineer
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Built web endpoints using Python. No experience with FastAPI.

cases.rationale: FastAPI is explicitly denied. Docker is unmentioned in substantive text.

candidate_profile.headline: Python Backend Developer
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Built REST endpoints with Django. Currently learning FastAPI and Docker.

cases.rationale: The candidate expresses learning intent for both technologies.

candidate_profile.headline: Release Coordinator
candidate_profile.experience_summary: The company built a FastAPI platform. Engineers at another vendor built Docker images. I scheduled release meetings and wrote status reports.

cases.rationale: Both technical claims are attributed to others, including one whose actor is outside the existing third-party cue list.

candidate_profile.headline: Implementation Coordinator
candidate_profile.experience_summary: The job posting said “Developed Python services with FastAPI”. I organized onboarding and wrote meeting notes.

cases.rationale: The quoted Python and FastAPI work are requisition text. The candidate claims coordination only.

candidate_profile.headline: Python FastAPI Docker Python FastAPI Docker
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Python FastAPI Docker Python FastAPI Docker. Python FastAPI Docker Python FastAPI Docker.

cases.rationale: Repeated keywords appear in unqualified prose rather than in the declared skills field or a work claim.
A repeated denial conflicts with direct project use and no chronology resolves the contradiction.

sections.projects: Later built a FastAPI web service for volunteer scheduling.

cases.rationale: The text explicitly places the gap in the past and a direct project claim later.

candidate_profile.headline: Textile Exhibit Conservator
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Repaired antique woven panels, controlled humidity in display cases, and documented fiber damage.

cases.rationale: There is substantive but unrelated work and none of the listed technologies appear.

semantic_order: API delivery is closer to the job topic than textile conservation.
Work on other web API frameworks is still topically relevant.
One framework denial does not erase a shared API engineering topic.
qualification_order: The former supplies both mandatory technologies.
The latter explicitly denies mandatory FastAPI experience.
The latter supplies no meaningful skill claims.
The latter has unresolved FastAPI claims.

job_requisition.title: Senior Streaming Platform Lead
job_requisition.description: Lead a streaming platform team, own architecture and incident response, and mentor engineers. Requires five years running distributed Kafka and Spark pipelines in production.

sections.experience: Led a team of six engineers for seven years. Operated Kafka pipelines in production. Managed Spark jobs and configured Kubernetes deployments. Owned incident response and coached engineers.

cases.rationale: The work section explicitly supports each technology and the leadership requirement.

candidate_profile.headline: Streaming Platform Intern
candidate_profile.experience_summary: One summer internship. Practiced on sample data in a sandbox and observed incident response. I have never led a team.

cases.rationale: All technologies are declared, while the stated duration and role fail the seniority requirement.

candidate_profile.headline: Satellite Telemetry Operations Lead
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Led an on-call team for nine years. Tuned real-time sensor event queues, restored backlogged readings after outages, and coordinated automatic restart of container workloads. Implemented Apache Pulsar pipelines.

cases.rationale: Adjacent operating skills carry over, but Apache Pulsar is a separate technology and the required products are unmentioned.

candidate_profile.headline: Senior Museum Educator
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Led eight years of tours and designed classroom materials for ancient art exhibitions.

cases.rationale: Generic leadership overlaps, while the subject and work differ from data streaming.

semantic_order: The work covers production streaming and leadership.
The declared technologies and work topic are closer despite the seniority gap.
Production event flow and on-call work are closer to streaming operations.
qualification_order: Both list the technologies, while only the former supplies the experience and leadership requested.
The latter has relevant operations experience with different technologies.

job_requisition.title: Go Microservices Engineer
job_requisition.description: Implement concurrent Go backend services and gRPC endpoints. Maintain production service-to-service APIs.

candidate_profile.headline: Distributed Services Engineer
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Implemented Golang worker pools for service-to-service calls. Created gRPC endpoints for production traffic.

cases.rationale: Golang denotes the same language as Go. gRPC use is explicit.

candidate_profile.headline: Customer Support Account Coordinator
candidate_profile.experience_summary: I designed a go-live checklist for customer onboarding. Built a calendar of board game club events after work.

cases.rationale: Go-live and board game references carry no programming-language claim.
The single structured Go declaration is valid. There is insufficient material to judge gRPC.
No candidate material exists for either skill.

semantic_order: The same language under an alternative name and production RPC work are semantically closer.
A valid language declaration supplies some relevance signal.
qualification_order: Only the former describes work in the mandatory language.
Only the former makes a candidate claim about the language. Proficiency remains unverified.

job_requisition.title: Data Protection Operations Analyst
job_requisition.description: Operate Data Loss Prevention controls that identify sensitive records and prevent unauthorized transfers. Triage and investigate alerts in a SIEM.

sections.experience: Configured Data Loss Prevention for file uploads. Investigated unauthorized transfers using SIEM dashboards.

cases.rationale: The experience field names both technologies in direct work claims.

candidate_profile.headline: Information Protection Analyst
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Configured DLP policies that quarantined sensitive exports. Investigated alerts using a security information and event management tool.

cases.rationale: DLP expands to the job's mandatory skill and SIEM is described by its expanded name.

candidate_profile.headline: Clinical Records Compliance Coordinator
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Audited outbound patient record requests, escalated unauthorized disclosures, and designed access reviews. Maintained an incident intake queue for compliance staff.

cases.rationale: The work addresses a related risk using different processes and does not identify either product category.

candidate_profile.headline: Concert Lighting Designer
candidate_profile.experience_summary: Designed stage lighting, programmed dimmer cues, and loaded fixtures for touring acts.

cases.rationale: The candidate's subject matter is unrelated and no target skill is stated.

semantic_order: Sensitive data quarantine and incident investigation are close to the role topic.
Clinical records controls share the goal of preventing unauthorized disclosure.
Direct data protection work is closer than concert lighting.
qualification_order: Only the former states work operating the required controls.
Only the former directly demonstrates the mandatory control.
